findings.title: Facebook: il Garante Privacy sanziona Meta per 805 milioni di euro (Garante press release)
findings.summary_md: Italy's data protection authority, the Garante, announced on 14 November 2026 that it fined Meta Platforms Ireland Limited EUR 805 million for accessing photographs, videos, and related metadata stored on the Android phones of Italian users through the Facebook feature "Get suggestions from gallery when browsing Facebook", available since 2023, without specific consent and without adequate notice. The investigation opened in July 2025 following a report from the Centro Tutela Consumatori Utenti di Bolzano and included a technical analysis carried out by the Authority. The Garante found the feature was enabled by default, that gallery access was requested through a single app-wide authorization covering multiple functions behind a generic "enable other functions" notice, and that such an authorization could let the app read the entire photo library, usually in a permanent way. The Authority rejected Meta's objection in favor of the Irish regulator, noted the ePrivacy rule (art. 122 of the Privacy Code) does not provide for the one-stop-shop mechanism, ordered the function disabled by default within 60 days with reporting to the Garante at 30 and 90 days, and stated the proceeding did not cover any use of gallery content to train AI.
